name: Deep Sea Diver
desc: Old brass-helmet deep-sea diver drifting mid-water on incommensurate currents — riveted helmet with a reflective porthole, air hose curling up and out of frame, slow striding legs in weighted boots, a hand lamp sweeping a light cone, bubbles streaming from the valve, kelp swaying behind, and fish silhouettes passing. Styles: polished brass, sepia vintage photo, deep-neon, rusty salvage, and a pale ghost diver.
